mapper.sql: c.id, c.anime_id, c.user_id, c.parent_id, c.reply_to_user_id, c.content, c.images, c.like_count, c.dislike_count, c.created_at, u.username, u.avatar_url, rt.username as reply_to_username
mapper.select: select from comment c inner join user u on c.user_id = u.id left join user rt on c.reply_to_user_id = rt.id where c.id = #{id}
select from comment c inner join user u on c.user_id = u.id left join user rt on c.reply_to_user_id = rt.id where c.anime_id = #{animeId} and c.parent_id is null order by c.created_at desc
select from comment c inner join user u on c.user_id = u.id left join user rt on c.reply_to_user_id = rt.id where c.parent_id in #{rid} order by c.parent_id, c.created_at desc
select parent_id as rootId, count(*) as cnt from comment where parent_id in #{rid} group by parent_id
select from comment c inner join user u on c.user_id = u.id left join user rt on c.reply_to_user_id = rt.id where c.parent_id = #{parentId} order by c.created_at asc
